data.name: Hafeezah
data.gender_notes: Hafeezah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who preserves, protects or keeps safe. The name Hafeezah carries the meaning “Protector, Preserver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Hafeezah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, preserver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A guardian of knowledge and wisdom
data.etymology: Hafeezah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Preserver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hafeezah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حفيظة
in_arabic.meaning: حفيظة تعني الحافظة لله أو الحافظة لشيء ما
in_arabic.long_meaning: حفيظة هي اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل حَفِظَ، والذي يعني الحفاظ أو الحفظ. في اللغة العربية، الحفيظة تعني الحافظة لله أو الحافظة لشيء ما. وفي القرآن الكريم، يتم استخدام مشتقات هذا الفعل في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: {إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا وَآثَارَهُمْ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ فِي إِمَامٍ مُبِينٍ} (يس: ١٢). الحفيظة هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى الالتزام بالحفاظ على شيء ما، سواء كان ذلك الحفاظ على الدين أو الأمان أو غير ذلك.

in_urdu.name: حفیظہ
in_urdu.meaning: حفیظہ کا مطلب ہے محافظ یا حفاظت کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: حفیظہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے محافظ یا حفاظت کرنے والی۔ یہ نام حفیظ فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت کرنا یا محفوظ کرنا۔ اسلامی روایت میں، حفیظہ کا نام ان خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک مسلمانہ کو اپنے دین، اپنے خاندان اور اپنے مجتمع کے لیے محافظ بناتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: हफ़ीज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: हफ़ीज़ा का अर्थ है रक्षक या रक्षा करने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: हफ़ीज़ा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है रक्षक या रक्षा करने वाली। यह नाम हफ़ीज़ क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है रक्षा करना या सुरक्षित करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, हफ़ीज़ा नाम उन विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है जो एक मुस्लिम महिला को अपने धर्म, अपने परिवार और अपने समुदाय के लिए रक्षक बनाती हैं।

in_pashto.name: حفيظه
in_pashto.meaning: حفيظه د محافظ یا حفاظت کوونکې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حفيظه د عربي نوم څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د محافظ یا حفاظت کوونکې ده. دا نوم د حفِظَ فعل څخه مشتق شوی دی، چې د حفاظت کولو یا محفوظ کولو معنی لري. په اسلامي روایت کې، حفيظه داسې ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي چې يوه مسلمانه ښځه د خپل دين، خپلې کورنۍ او خپل ټولنې لپاره محافظه کونکې بنوي.

in_english.name: Hafeezah
in_english.meaning: Hafeezah means protector or one who preserves
in_english.long_meaning: Hafeezah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-f-ẓ', which means to protect, preserve, or guard. In Islamic tradition, Hafeezah signifies a person, particularly a woman, who safeguards her faith, family, and community. The name is associated with qualities of guardianship, preservation, and protection. In the Quran, similar roots are used in contexts emphasizing the preservation of knowledge, faith, and righteous deeds.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hafeezah holds a special place in Islamic culture, as it is associated with wisdom, knowledge, and protection. In various Islamic communities, individuals bearing this name are often held in high esteem due to their perceived intelligence, piety, and ability to safeguard and preserve important knowledge. Moreover, it is common for Hafeezah to be bestowed upon children as a name, with the hope and expectation that they will grow up to be knowledgeable, wise, and protective individuals who contribute positively to their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Hafeezah can be seen as a testament to the importance of preserving and protecting the knowledge of Allah (God) in one's heart, as well as in the broader Islamic community. Hafeezah is a reminder that as individuals, we are all responsible for safeguarding the precious teachings of Islam and striving to pass them down to future generations. By internalizing and applying this knowledge, we are able to protect ourselves from spiritual harm and draw closer to Allah, ultimately achieving true peace and contentment in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector, Preserver" symbolizes One who preserves, protects or keeps safe. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hafeezah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector, preserver.
